name: Elsewhere
subtitle: Change your iPhone's location for every app.

apps.name: Elsewhere
apps.subtitle: Teleport or drive anywhere — system-wide.
apps.localizedDescription: Tap the map to change the location every app sees, or drive a route at your own speed with realistic traffic. Verified status, instant alerts if your real location becomes visible, and a lock-screen Stop button. Requires iOS 17.4+, Developer Mode, LocalDevVPN and a pairing file.
